missing_data.issue: No occupation-level earnings observations for Japan in the ILOSTAT series used.
missing_data.treatment: Shown as unavailable; no estimate is substituted.

missing_data.issue: Canada reports occupation earnings under ISCO-88 rather than ISCO-08.
missing_data.treatment: Included with an explicit ISCO-88 major-group mapping and classification flag; not silently harmonised.

missing_data.issue: Canada reports ISIC Rev.3, which does not isolate information/communication (J) or motor-vehicle manufacturing (C29).
missing_data.treatment: These Canada sector series are shown as unavailable rather than approximated.

missing_data.issue: Sector-specific announced and realized investment are not available from the free official sources used.
missing_data.treatment: Columns are present but empty; the interface labels them unavailable.

missing_data.issue: Harmonised vacancy series across all six countries were not acquired.
missing_data.treatment: Columns are present but empty; vacancy views are disabled.

missing_data.issue: City-level expense observations are not available in the official series used; values are national.
missing_data.treatment: City is recorded as 'National'; no city-level estimate is fabricated.

missing_data.issue: Installed-capacity additions by sector are not available in the free series used.

sources.name: ILOSTAT — International Labour Organization
sources.license: ILO open data (CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated)
used_for: mean and median monthly earnings by occupation

method_notes.employment: ILOSTAT employment by economic activity × occupation. Section-level rows are available for all six countries and are broad proxies. Division-level rows are available only where ILOSTAT publishes ISIC Rev.4 two-digit data (India, Japan, United Kingdom, United States).
method_notes.salary: ILOSTAT average monthly earnings of employees by occupation, local currency, nominal. Real values use World Bank CPI (2010 = 100). PPP values divide by the World Bank private-consumption PPP conversion factor. No currency conversion is applied without one of these documented methods.
method_notes.country_sector: World Bank WDI indicators mapped to sectors as documented proxies. industrial_output is populated only for indicators with role='output'; all indicators also expose indicator_value and indicator_role.
method_notes.living_cost: National-level World Bank price and consumption indicators. City-level expense data has not been acquired.
method_notes.forecast: Forecasts are produced separately by scripts/forecast.py and are never mixed into historical files.
